text.en:
Casting [Air Move] with full Class Ability Energy consumes the charge and causes you to dive to the ground, <strand/>Suspending all enemies in an <pve 8 /> <pvp [6.5] /> meter radius on impact.

Gain 4 seconds of <strand/>Woven Mail per enemy <strand/>Suspended, up to a maximum of 20 seconds.

Ensnaring Slam triggers the effects of your equipped dodge upon consumption.
